explication: Agent Sprite Forge is a collection of agent-facing tools for producing game-ready 2D art, especially animated character sets. Its main workflow starts with an approved still, obtains image-to-video clips for actions, then gates, keys, registers, loops, retimes, finishes, and exports them for game engines. Separate skills generate code-authored art, maps, and media. The graph preserves these documented branches; several map and art-tool relationships are shown as components rather than an inferred execution sequence because their callers were not sampled.
